ameSoeurPortrait.introTitle: What does the person you need look like?
ameSoeurPortrait.q1: A perfect Sunday for two, to you:
ameSoeurPortrait.q1a: Nothing planned, at home, with no effort required.
ameSoeurPortrait.q1b: Heading off somewhere on a whim.
ameSoeurPortrait.q1c: A long conversation that stretches into the evening.
ameSoeurPortrait.q1d: Doing something together, without necessarily talking.
ameSoeurPortrait.q2: What you would miss most in a relationship:
ameSoeurPortrait.q2a: The certainty that the person will be there tomorrow.
ameSoeurPortrait.q2b: The thrill of not knowing what comes next.
ameSoeurPortrait.q2c: Being told what the other feels.
ameSoeurPortrait.q3: After a hard day, you would want the other person to:
ameSoeurPortrait.q3a: Change nothing and keep the usual rhythm.
ameSoeurPortrait.q3b: Pull you out of it and suggest something else.
ameSoeurPortrait.q3c: Ask what happened and listen to the end.
ameSoeurPortrait.q3d: Be there, make dinner, ask nothing.
ameSoeurPortrait.q4: A sign of love that really reaches you:
ameSoeurPortrait.q4a: Keeping a promise, even a small one.
ameSoeurPortrait.q4c: A sentence said at the right moment.
ameSoeurPortrait.q4d: A gesture, a hand on your shoulder.
ameSoeurPortrait.q5: What would make you doubt a relationship:
ameSoeurPortrait.q5a: Never knowing what you can count on.
ameSoeurPortrait.q5d: Them not being there when it matters.
ameSoeurPortrait.q6: You feel close to someone when:
ameSoeurPortrait.q6a: Your habits end up falling into step.
ameSoeurPortrait.q6b: You live through something new together.
ameSoeurPortrait.q6c: You tell each other what you had told no one.
ameSoeurPortrait.q6d: You share a silence without awkwardness.
ameSoeurPortrait.q7: The beginning of a story, you prefer it:
ameSoeurPortrait.q7a: Slow, built up little by little.
ameSoeurPortrait.q7c: Talkative, writing each other whole pages.
ameSoeurPortrait.q7d: Simple, seeing each other often without making it a topic.
ameSoeurPortrait.q8: What you would need in a difficult period:
ameSoeurPortrait.q8b: Someone who helps you get some air.
ameSoeurPortrait.q8c: Someone to talk to for hours.
ameSoeurPortrait.q8d: Someone who stays in the room.
ameSoeurPortrait.q9a: The same one we like to do again.
ameSoeurPortrait.q9c: We talked about everything and lost track of time.
ameSoeurPortrait.q9d: We did not do much, and it was good.
ameSoeurPortrait.q10: What would irritate you most in someone:
ameSoeurPortrait.q10b: Routine and a lack of appetite.
ameSoeurPortrait.q11c: Says it to you, in words.
ameSoeurPortrait.q11d: Makes themselves available without being asked.
ameSoeurPortrait.q12: The shared project that appeals to you most:
ameSoeurPortrait.q12a: A flat, some habits, a dog.
ameSoeurPortrait.q12b: A long trip, with no return date set.
ameSoeurPortrait.q12c: Knowing each other completely, with no grey areas.
ameSoeurPortrait.q12d: A life side by side, quiet.
ameSoeurPortrait.q13: When you are not doing well, you:
ameSoeurPortrait.q13a: Look for what is stable around you.
ameSoeurPortrait.q13b: Need to move, to do something.
ameSoeurPortrait.q13c: Need to talk it through to see clearly.
ameSoeurPortrait.q13d: Just want not to be alone.
ameSoeurPortrait.q14: An argument feels settled to you when:
ameSoeurPortrait.q14a: Normal life has resumed its course.
ameSoeurPortrait.q14b: We have moved on to something else together.
ameSoeurPortrait.q14c: Everything has been said, really everything.
ameSoeurPortrait.q14d: We find each other physically close again.
ameSoeurPortrait.q15: What matters most day to day:
ameSoeurPortrait.q16: You would rather choose someone who:
ameSoeurPortrait.q17: On social media, what you would expect:
ameSoeurPortrait.q17a: Nothing in particular, real life is enough.
ameSoeurPortrait.q17b: Sharing the exciting things we live.
ameSoeurPortrait.q18: A relationship that lasts rests mainly on:
ameSoeurPortrait.q19d: An absence at the wrong moment.
ameSoeurPortrait.q20: What you are looking for, in one word:
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_ancrage_d: What makes you feel safe is neither declarations nor surprises: it is knowing what you can count on. Someone who says a time and arrives at that time will move you more than someone who promises the moon. Your soulmate is the one whose word means something, and who is not frightened by routine.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_ancrage_a: Look for: someone whose actions and words match, on small things first. Avoid: dazzling beginnings with enormous plans announced within three weeks. That is not steadiness, that is speed, and it drops.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_elan_t: You need someone who sweeps you along
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_elan_d: You need movement. A relationship that settles into its habits too quickly suffocates you, even when everything else is fine. What you are looking for is someone with their own appetites who pulls you into them, not someone waiting for you to suggest things.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_elan_a: Look for: someone with a life of their own, plans that do not include you yet, and the desire to take you along. Avoid: mistaking momentum for instability. Someone unpredictable about their commitments is not someone full of life, they are someone you cannot count on.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_parole_d: The unsaid is unbearable to you, and you are right to know it: many relationships die of what nobody dared to name. You need to be told what is going on, what the other feels, what is wrong. Silence, for you, is not modesty, it is anxiety.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_parole_a: Look for: someone who can say "right now, I am not doing well" without you having to guess it. Avoid: taking eloquence for sincerity. Some people talk a great deal and say nothing true.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_presence_t: You need someone who is there
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_presence_d: You are not asking for grand sentences, nor surprises, nor even guarantees: you are asking for a presence. Someone in the room, someone who stays, someone with whom silence is not a problem. It is the simplest need to put into words and the hardest to find, because it does not show on the first few dates.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_presence_a: Look for: someone who makes themselves available without being asked, and who likes being there doing nothing. Avoid: the presence that is only a front, that of someone sitting next to you and absent everywhere else.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_equilibre_d: Your answers lean clearly in no direction, and that is information in itself. Either you adapt a great deal, which is a quality as long as it does not become a way of never stating what you need. Or you do not know yet, which is perfectly normal and is discovered by living relationships, not by taking tests.
ameSoeurPortrait.pf_equilibre_a: Look for: the moments when you felt genuinely good with someone, and what exactly was happening then. That is more reliable than any list. Avoid: the phrase "I adapt to anything", which often ends up meaning "I ask for nothing".
